changes.comment: SqliteVecVectorIndex gains has(target); SqliteVecFragmentIndex gains has(target) and a real rebuild(source, embed, options?) — it previously had no backfill in any form, so a persistent fragment index could not be reconciled. Semantics are kept observably identical to the in-memory siblings: a list failure is fatal and leaves the durable table untouched, a genuine rebuild clears first, onRecordError defaults to 'fail', and a failure carries what the attempt established on the detail. A rollback that itself fails is composed into the error rather than swallowed, since on a durable table a botched rollback survives the process.
